scientific_integrity: Finite-dimensional exact Lindblad computation with rigorous all-size symmetry reduction; independently implemented numerical comparisons support but do not establish the proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform on-site energy, hopping and dephasing; one excitation, one absorbing leaf, another localized initial leaf, gamma and kappa positive; no disorder, many-body, non-Markovian or experimental assertions. Priority is provisional after examined literature searches.
title: Peripheral trapping on a dephased quantum star has an exact \(m^{3/2}\) optimum
